paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
1. Inilah yang disebut Usadha Lare, sebagai pedoman pengenalan tanda-tanda pada anak/bayi. Perhatikanlah dengan seksama petunjuk atau tanda-tanda panas-dingin ini.

Perhatikanlah mata anak tersebut: jika matanya tampak kebiruan, disertai semburat kemerahan atau kekuningan, dan air matanya keluar terasa panas, maka itu menandakan kondisi panas.

Serta jika matanya tampak kekuningan hingga ke bagian pupil/anak matanya menguning, itu juga menandakan panas. Apabila badan anak tersebut berbintik-bintik, bulu roma meremang/berdiri, rambutnya kaku berdiri ke atas, dan pada tangannya terasa dorongan hawa yang kencang bergetar, sungguh itu pertanda penyakit panas pada anak.
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
1. This is Usadha Lare, serving as guidance for recognizing signs in children/infants. Observe carefully these indicators of feverish heat and chills.

Observe the child's eyes: if the eyes appear bluish, tinged with reddish or yellowish hues, and tears emerge warm/hot, that indicates a feverish state.

Furthermore, if the eyes appear yellowish extending to the pupils turning yellowish, that also signifies fever. If the child's body exhibits spots/bumps, the body hair bristles, the head hair stands stiffly upward, and a strong fluttering pulse/heat emanates from the hands, it is truly indicative of a fever condition.

ethnomedicinal_entity.preparation_instructions: Teks memuat diagnosis/tanda-tanda klinis penyakit panas dan dingin (panes tis) pada anak (Usadha Lare) melalui pengamatan mata, rambut, kulit, dan denyut tangan, tanpa menyertakan resep atau ramuan obat.

paleography.indonesian_translation:
Inilah ajaran pengobatan anak-anak (Usada Lare), sebagai tanda pengenal kondisi sang anak, perhatikanlah dengan saksama. Inilah tanda-tanda panas-dingin:
Perhatikanlah mata anak tersebut. Bila matanya tampak kebiruan serta memperlihatkan bintik darah dan bernuansa kuning gading, air matanya keluar terasa panas, maka orang yang demikian menderita panas.
Dan jika matanya bernuansa gading, hingga pupil/manik matanya pun kekuningan, orang yang demikian juga menderita panas. Serta jika sekujur tubuh sang anak berbintik-bintik/bentol-bentol, bulu romanya berdiri tegak, rambutnya mencuat ke atas, dari tangannya keluar hembusan hawa yang sangat deras menderu-deru, nyatalah orang tersebut menderita panas.
paleography.english_translation:
This is the Usada Lare (pediatric traditional medicine), serving as diagnostic signs for children; observe with care. These are the symptoms of hot and cold conditions:
Observe the child's eyes. If the eyes appear bluish and bloodshot, tinted yellowish-ivory, and their tears come out warm, then such an individual has a feverish (hot) condition.
Furthermore, if their eyes are yellowish-ivory, extending to the pupils appearing ivory-yellow, such a person also suffers from a hot condition. If the child's body develops rashes/bumps, goosebumps rise, hair stands on end, and their hands emit a strong rushing warm breeze, it is certain that such an individual suffers from a hot condition.

paleography.transliteration:
[Lembar 1]
... padha mapulang ri jro kuta, prang ... / ... krodha mangkin gumawe sengit, ya ...
ring kapwa pada krodha, wetu pati / teka ring padha pati palugwa, ya ...
kapwa pada manggalih sanghyang hyang / ngiring sang nata krodha pati mang ...
pupul mapupul, mangkana ring ... / kadi pasang pati ring rātri.

[Lembar 2]
... ring kuta sanghyang, pati reba ... / apan sang hyang ring kuta katon mang ...
ka, patitis rengeng gaganata mangkwa / tatkala sang hyang mangka kadi ...
ring gaga ring mangka, mangiring mang ... / ngiring sang nata mangkin, mangka ...
ring dina mangkin, mangda ring sang ... / kapwa pada mangayubagya.
paleography.indonesian_translation:
[Lembar 1]
Semua berkumpul di dalam benteng/kota, pertempuran... amarah makin memicu dendam, ya...
Kedua pihak sama-sama marah, timbul kematian... hingga saling berhadapan satu sama lain dalam maut...
Semuanya mengingat para dewata... mengiringi sang raja yang marah besar...
Berkumpul dan berhimpun, demikianlah... bagaikan pasang surut maut di waktu malam.

[Lembar 2]
... di kota/istana sanghyang, kematian... karena sanghyang di benteng/istana terlihat demikian...
... tepat terfokus pada angkasa sekarang... tatkala sanghyang bagaikan...
... mengiringi... mengiringi sang raja saat ini, demikianlah...
pada hari ini, agar kepada sang... semuanya saling mengucap rasa syukur/berbahagia.
paleography.english_translation:
[Leaf 1]
All gathered within the stronghold/city, the battle... anger further incited enmity, yea...
Both sides were equally enraged, bringing forth death... until facing one another unto death...
All meditated upon the sacred deities... accompanying the wrathful king...
Gathering together, thus... like the tide of death in the night.

[Leaf 2]
... in the stronghold of the divine, death... for the divine presence in the fort was seen thus...
... sharply focused towards the firmament now... when the divine was as if...
... accompanying... accompanying the king at this time, thus...
on this day, so that unto... all rejoiced together in gratitude.
